title: Compatible lifting along one monomorphism of split injective towers
statement: For a tower I of injective abelian groups with split transition maps, every morphism g:A→I extends along every monomorphism f:A→B of towers.

source.place: Tag 07KW, Lemma 15.88.1 proof footnote, compatible lifting induction

proof.text: Perform the level-by-level extension and correction through the kernel of each split transition exactly as in the compatible lifting argument of Tag 07KW.
